items.question: Trong câu "Analysing, prioritising and preparing backlog items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition", từ "analyse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysing, prioritising and preparing backlog items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition", what does "analyse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to combine parts into a whole
to make a copy of something
items.explanation: analyse /ˈæn.əl.aɪz/ (động từ): phân tích. Analyse a problem/requirement = phân tích vấn đề/yêu cầu; danh từ là analysis, người làm là analyst (BA = business analyst).
items.explanationEn: analyse /ˈæn.əl.aɪz/ (verb): to examine something in detail. Analyse a problem or requirement; the noun is analysis and the person is an analyst, as in business analyst.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysing, prioritising and preparing backlog items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition", từ "prioritise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysing, prioritising and preparing backlog items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition", what does "prioritise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritise /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (động từ): sắp thứ tự ưu tiên. Prioritise the backlog = sắp xếp backlog theo mức ưu tiên; danh từ priority (mức ưu tiên), số nhiều priorities.
items.explanationEn: prioritise /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (verb): to rank things by importance. Prioritise the backlog means ordering it by importance; the noun is priority, plural priorities.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysing, prioritising and preparing backlog items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition", từ "decomposition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysing, prioritising and preparing backlog items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition", what does "decomposition" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: putting things in a new order
items.explanation: decomposition /ˌdiː.kɒm.pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): sự chia nhỏ thành phần. Story decomposition = chia một story lớn thành các story nhỏ hơn; nghĩa khác trong sinh học là sự phân hủy.
items.explanationEn: decomposition /ˌdiː.kɒm.pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (noun): breaking something into smaller parts. Story decomposition means splitting a big story into smaller ones; in biology the word means rotting.

items.question: Trong câu "Identifying the detailed tasks needed to complete each item — that belongs to the planning workshop", từ "detailed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Identifying the detailed tasks needed to complete each item — that belongs to the planning workshop", what does "detailed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: detailed /ˈdiː.teɪld/ (tính từ): chi tiết, cụ thể. Detailed tasks/design = công việc/thiết kế chi tiết; trái nghĩa: high-level (tổng quan).
items.explanationEn: detailed /ˈdiː.teɪld/ (adjective): including many small facts. Detailed tasks or design contain the small specifics; the opposite is high-level.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning the tasks needed to complete the upcoming iteration (at delivery); feature order and the release plan (at initiative); goals and metrics (at strategy)", từ "upcoming" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning the tasks needed to complete the upcoming iteration (at delivery); feature order and the release plan (at initiative); goals and metrics (at strategy)", what does "upcoming" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: upcoming /ˈʌpˌkʌm.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): sắp tới. The upcoming iteration/release = vòng lặp/bản phát hành sắp tới.
items.explanationEn: upcoming /ˈʌpˌkʌm.ɪŋ/ (adjective): about to happen soon. The upcoming iteration or release is the next one that will happen soon.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning the tasks needed to complete the upcoming iteration (at delivery); feature order and the release plan (at initiative); goals and metrics (at strategy)", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning the tasks needed to complete the upcoming iteration (at delivery); feature order and the release plan (at initiative); goals and metrics (at strategy)", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
options: lời nói nhắc đi nhắc lại
vòng lặp phát triển (chu kỳ ngắn)
cuộc họp tổng kết dự án
optionsEn: a statement said again and again
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): vòng lặp phát triển (chu kỳ ngắn). Trong agile, iteration là một chu kỳ ngắn (như sprint); cụm: plan the next iteration.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪt.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a short repeated development cycle. In agile an iteration is a short, repeated cycle such as a sprint; e.g. plan the next iteration.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning the tasks needed to complete the upcoming iteration (at delivery); feature order and the release plan (at initiative); goals and metrics (at strategy)", từ "metric" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning the tasks needed to complete the upcoming iteration (at delivery); feature order and the release plan (at initiative); goals and metrics (at strategy)", what does "metric" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a unit in the metric system
a measure used to track results
items.explanation: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (danh từ): chỉ số đo lường. Goals and metrics = mục tiêu và chỉ số đo; cụm: success metrics (chỉ số thành công).
items.explanationEn: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (noun): a measure used to track results. Goals and metrics go together; a common phrase is success metrics.

items.question: Trong câu "Showing an increment of the completed, working solution to users and stakeholders to get feedback on its alignment to the user need", từ "increment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Showing an increment of the completed, working solution to users and stakeholders to get feedback on its alignment to the user need", what does "increment" (noun) mean?
options: phần sản phẩm được bổ sung
optionsEn: an added piece of the product
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (danh từ): phần sản phẩm được bổ sung. Trong agile, increment là phần sản phẩm chạy được vừa hoàn thành; nghĩa chung là lượng tăng thêm.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (noun): an added piece of the product. In agile an increment is a newly finished, working piece of the product; generally it means an amount added.

items.question: Trong câu "Showing an increment of the completed, working solution to users and stakeholders to get feedback on its alignment to the user need", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Showing an increment of the completed, working solution to users and stakeholders to get feedback on its alignment to the user need", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person affected by the project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. Stakeholders = những người có lợi ích hoặc bị ảnh hưởng bởi dự án; cụm: engage/manage stakeholders.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a person affected by the project. Stakeholders have an interest in or are affected by the work; common phrases: engage or manage stakeholders.

items.question: Trong câu "Showing an increment of the completed, working solution to users and stakeholders to get feedback on its alignment to the user need", từ "alignment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Showing an increment of the completed, working solution to users and stakeholders to get feedback on its alignment to the user need", what does "alignment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the positioning of text on a page
how well something matches a goal
items.explanation: alignment /əˈlaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự phù hợp, khớp với. Alignment to/with the user need = mức độ khớp với nhu cầu người dùng; động từ align (with).
items.explanationEn: alignment /əˈlaɪn.mənt/ (noun): how well something matches a goal. Alignment to or with a need is how well something fits it; the verb is align with.

items.question: Trong câu "Explicitly discussing opportunities for continuous improvement of the process and the way of working", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Explicitly discussing opportunities for continuous improvement of the process and the way of working", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách rõ ràng, công khai
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, công khai. Explicitly discuss/state = thảo luận/nêu rõ ràng; trái nghĩa: implicitly (ngầm).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and openly. Explicitly discuss or state something means doing it openly; the opposite is implicitly.

items.question: Trong câu "Explicitly discussing opportunities for continuous improvement of the process and the way of working", từ "opportunity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Explicitly discussing opportunities for continuous improvement of the process and the way of working", what does "opportunity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: opportunity /ˌɒp.əˈtjuː.nə.ti/ (danh từ): cơ hội. Opportunities for improvement = cơ hội để cải tiến; cụm: seize an opportunity (nắm bắt cơ hội).
items.explanationEn: opportunity /ˌɒp.əˈtjuː.nə.ti/ (noun): a chance to do something. Opportunities for improvement are chances to get better; collocation: seize an opportunity.

items.question: Trong câu "A reading heuristic: if the question describes looking forward (preparing, planning) it is refinement or planning; if it describes looking back it is the review (looking back at the product) or the retrospective (looking back at the way of working).", từ "heuristic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A reading heuristic: if the question describes looking forward (preparing, planning) it is refinement or planning; if it describes looking back it is the review (looking back at the product) or the retrospective (looking back at the way of working).", what does "heuristic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: heuristic /hjʊəˈrɪs.tɪk/ (danh từ): mẹo, quy tắc kinh nghiệm. A heuristic giúp ra quyết định nhanh, không đảm bảo luôn đúng; gần nghĩa: rule of thumb.
items.explanationEn: heuristic /hjʊəˈrɪs.tɪk/ (noun): a practical rule of thumb. A heuristic helps you decide quickly without guaranteeing correctness; similar to a rule of thumb.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most frequently swapped pair of the four, and the boundary is sharp", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most frequently swapped pair of the four, and the boundary is sharp", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
options: nhầm lẫn, đổi chỗ cho nhau
optionsEn: to exchange one for the other
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): nhầm lẫn, đổi chỗ cho nhau. Swap A and B = đổi chỗ A và B; "frequently swapped pair" = cặp hay bị nhầm với nhau.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to exchange one for the other. Swap A and B means exchange them; a frequently swapped pair is one people often confuse.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most frequently swapped pair of the four, and the boundary is sharp", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most frequently swapped pair of the four, and the boundary is sharp", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. The boundary between A and B = ranh giới giữa A và B; "the boundary is sharp" = ranh giới rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a dividing line. The boundary between A and B separates them; a sharp boundary is a clear one.

items.question: Trong câu "This is where stories are elaborated and decomposed.", từ "elaborate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where stories are elaborated and decomposed.", what does "elaborate" (verb) mean?
options: làm rõ, bổ sung chi tiết
items.explanation: elaborate /ɪˈlæb.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): làm rõ, bổ sung chi tiết. Elaborate on something = nói/viết chi tiết hơn; tính từ elaborate /ɪˈlæb.ər.ət/ nghĩa là công phu, cầu kỳ.
items.explanationEn: elaborate /ɪˈlæb.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to add detail and clarify. Elaborate on something means give more detail; the adjective elaborate means intricate or complex.

items.question: Trong câu "The reverse also holds: backlog refinement is the key input to a planning workshop.", từ "hold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reverse also holds: backlog refinement is the key input to a planning workshop.", what does "hold" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hold /həʊld/ (động từ): vẫn đúng, có hiệu lực. "The reverse also holds" = điều ngược lại cũng đúng; cụm: this rule holds for all cases.
items.explanationEn: hold /həʊld/ (verb): to remain true. The reverse also holds means the opposite statement is also true; e.g. this rule holds for all cases.

items.question: Trong câu "Without a refined backlog, the planning session has nothing to plan.", từ "refined" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a refined backlog, the planning session has nothing to plan.", what does "refined" (adjective) mean?
options: đã được làm rõ, hoàn thiện
items.explanation: refined /rɪˈfaɪnd/ (tính từ): đã được làm rõ, hoàn thiện. A refined backlog = backlog đã được làm rõ và sẵn sàng; động từ refine, danh từ refinement.
items.explanationEn: refined /rɪˈfaɪnd/ (adjective): clarified and made ready. A refined backlog has been clarified and made ready; the verb is refine and the noun refinement.

items.question: Trong câu "Three things that genuinely do belong to backlog refinement, and that show up as distractors: analysing/prioritising/preparing items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition.", từ "distractor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three things that genuinely do belong to backlog refinement, and that show up as distractors: analysing/prioritising/preparing items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition.", what does "distractor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a wrong but tempting answer choice
items.explanation: distractor /dɪˈstræk.tər/ (danh từ): phương án gây nhiễu. Trong trắc nghiệm, distractors là các phương án sai nhưng dễ gây nhầm.
items.explanationEn: distractor /dɪˈstræk.tər/ (noun): a wrong but tempting answer choice. In multiple-choice tests, distractors are the plausible wrong options.

items.question: Trong câu "Three things that genuinely do belong to backlog refinement, and that show up as distractors: analysing/prioritising/preparing items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three things that genuinely do belong to backlog refinement, and that show up as distractors: analysing/prioritising/preparing items; reviewing priorities and removing items; story elaboration and story decomposition.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (trạng từ): thực sự. Genuinely belong/care = thực sự thuộc về/quan tâm; tính từ genuine (thật, chân thành).
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (adverb): truly, really. Genuinely belong or care means truly so; the adjective is genuine.

items.question: Trong câu "In a review, what is demonstrated is an increment of the completed solution — working product.", từ "demonstrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a review, what is demonstrated is an increment of the completed solution — working product.", what does "demonstrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (động từ): trình diễn, cho xem. Demonstrate a feature = trình diễn tính năng; danh từ demonstration (demo). Nghĩa khác: biểu tình.
items.explanationEn: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (verb): to show how something works. Demonstrate a feature means show it working; the noun is demonstration or demo. Another sense is to protest.

items.question: Trong câu "UI mockups — they do not demonstrate anything working.", từ "mockup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UI mockups — they do not demonstrate anything working.", what does "mockup" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a model of a screen design
items.explanation: mockup /ˈmɒk.ʌp/ (danh từ): bản mô phỏng giao diện. UI mockup = bản mô phỏng giao diện, chưa chạy thật; gần nghĩa: wireframe, prototype.
items.explanationEn: mockup /ˈmɒk.ʌp/ (noun): a model of a screen design. A UI mockup shows how a screen will look but does not work; related: wireframe, prototype.

items.question: Trong câu "The code — a piece behind the scenes, not working product.", từ "behind the scenes" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The code — a piece behind the scenes, not working product.", what does "behind the scenes" (phrase) mean?
options: phía sau, không lộ ra ngoài
items.explanation: behind the scenes /bɪˈhaɪnd ðə siːnz/ (cụm từ): phía sau, không lộ ra ngoài. Behind the scenes = ở hậu trường, người dùng không nhìn thấy; ví dụ code, bảng cấu hình.
items.explanationEn: behind the scenes /bɪˈhaɪnd ðə siːnz/ (phrase): out of public view. Behind the scenes means hidden from users, like code or configuration tables.

items.question: Trong câu "And why teams hold reviews: to get feedback from stakeholders on the increment's alignment to user needs.", từ "hold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "And why teams hold reviews: to get feedback from stakeholders on the increment's alignment to user needs.", what does "hold" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to organise a meeting or event
items.explanation: hold /həʊld/ (động từ): tổ chức (cuộc họp). Hold a review/meeting = tổ chức buổi review/cuộc họp.
items.explanationEn: hold /həʊld/ (verb): to organise a meeting or event. Hold a review or meeting means organise and run it.

items.question: Trong câu "And why teams hold reviews: to get feedback from stakeholders on the increment's alignment to user needs.", từ "feedback" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "And why teams hold reviews: to get feedback from stakeholders on the increment's alignment to user needs.", what does "feedback" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (danh từ): ý kiến phản hồi. Get/give feedback on something = nhận/đưa phản hồi về cái gì; là danh từ không đếm được.
items.explanationEn: feedback /ˈfiːd.bæk/ (noun): opinions given in response. Get or give feedback on something; it is uncountable, so say some feedback, not a feedback.

items.question: Trong câu "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", từ "approval" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", what does "approval" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: approval /əˈpruː.vəl/ (danh từ): sự phê duyệt. Get/seek approval = xin/được phê duyệt; động từ approve.
items.explanationEn: approval /əˈpruː.vəl/ (noun): official permission. Get or seek approval; the verb is approve.

items.question: Trong câu "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", từ "gate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", what does "gate" (noun) mean?
options: điểm kiểm soát (phải qua mới đi tiếp)
optionsEn: a boarding door at an airport
items.explanation: gate /ɡeɪt/ (danh từ): điểm kiểm soát (phải qua mới đi tiếp). Approval gate / quality gate = điểm kiểm soát phải được duyệt trước khi đi tiếp.
items.explanationEn: gate /ɡeɪt/ (noun): a checkpoint you must pass. An approval gate or quality gate is a checkpoint that must be passed before moving on.

items.question: Trong câu "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", từ "dialogue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", what does "dialogue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dialogue /ˈdaɪ.ə.lɒɡ/ (danh từ): sự trao đổi, đối thoại. Open a dialogue with stakeholders = mở cuộc trao đổi với các bên liên quan.
items.explanationEn: dialogue /ˈdaɪ.ə.lɒɡ/ (noun): an open exchange of views. Open a dialogue with stakeholders means start a two-way conversation with them.

items.question: Trong câu "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", từ "sign-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Getting approval — a review is not an approval gate; feedback is given, but for learning and dialogue, not sign-off.", what does "sign-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sign-off /ˈsaɪn.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự ký duyệt chính thức. Get sign-off = được ký duyệt; động từ sign off on something.
items.explanationEn: sign-off /ˈsaɪn.ɒf/ (noun): formal final approval. Get sign-off means receive formal approval; the verb is sign off on something.

items.question: Trong câu "Peer-reviewing code — not part of a review as defined by the Agile Extension v2.", từ "peer-review" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Peer-reviewing code — not part of a review as defined by the Agile Extension v2.", what does "peer-review" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be graded by a manager
items.explanation: peer-review /ˈpɪə rɪˌvjuː/ (động từ): được đồng nghiệp xem xét. Peer-review code = đồng nghiệp rà soát code của nhau; peer = người ngang hàng.
items.explanationEn: peer-review /ˈpɪə rɪˌvjuː/ (verb): to have colleagues check work. Peer-review code means colleagues check each other's work; a peer is an equal.

items.question: Trong câu "The retrospective is the delivery-horizon technique used as a means of explicitly discussing opportunities for continuous improvement.", từ "means" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The retrospective is the delivery-horizon technique used as a means of explicitly discussing opportunities for continuous improvement.", what does "means" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a method or way of doing
items.explanation: means /miːnz/ (danh từ): phương tiện, cách thức. A means of doing something = cách để làm gì; dạng số ít và số nhiều giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: means /miːnz/ (noun): a method or way of doing. A means of doing something is a way to do it; singular and plural are the same.

items.question: Trong câu "That phrase is the identifying cue; if it appears in the stem, you need not read the other three options.", từ "cue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That phrase is the identifying cue; if it appears in the stem, you need not read the other three options.", what does "cue" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a signal that hints at something
items.explanation: cue /kjuː/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu gợi ý. Identifying cue = dấu hiệu nhận diện; đừng nhầm với queue (hàng đợi) cùng phát âm.
items.explanationEn: cue /kjuː/ (noun): a signal that hints at something. An identifying cue is a signal that tells you the answer; do not confuse it with queue, which sounds the same.

items.question: Trong câu "That phrase is the identifying cue; if it appears in the stem, you need not read the other three options.", từ "stem" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That phrase is the identifying cue; if it appears in the stem, you need not read the other three options.", what does "stem" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the question part of a test item
the stalk of a wine glass
items.explanation: stem /stem/ (danh từ): phần đề của câu hỏi. Trong trắc nghiệm, stem là phần câu hỏi, còn options là các lựa chọn.
items.explanationEn: stem /stem/ (noun): the question part of a test item. In a multiple-choice item the stem is the question and the options are the choices.

items.question: Trong câu "The key output of a retrospective is a list of action items.", từ "output" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key output of a retrospective is a list of action items.", what does "output" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (danh từ): kết quả đầu ra. Key output = đầu ra chính; cặp đối lập: input / output.
items.explanationEn: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (noun): the result produced. The key output is the main result; its opposite is input.

items.question: Trong câu "The key output of a retrospective is a list of action items.", từ "action item" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key output of a retrospective is a list of action items.", what does "action item" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a follow-up task to carry out
items.explanation: action item /ˈæk.ʃən ˌaɪ.təm/ (cụm từ): việc cần làm tiếp theo. Action items = danh sách việc cần làm sau cuộc họp, thường có người phụ trách và hạn.
items.explanationEn: action item /ˈæk.ʃən ˌaɪ.təm/ (phrase): a follow-up task to carry out. Action items are follow-up tasks from a meeting, usually with an owner and a due date.

items.question: Trong câu "A list of completed stories — this may be an input to a retrospective, but never its output.", từ "input" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A list of completed stories — this may be an input to a retrospective, but never its output.", what does "input" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (danh từ): thông tin đầu vào. An input to a meeting = thông tin dùng làm đầu vào cho cuộc họp; cũng có nghĩa ý kiến đóng góp.
items.explanationEn: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (noun): information that goes in. An input to a meeting is material fed into it; it can also mean contributed opinions.

items.question: Trong câu "A task list per person — some tasks may be determined, but that is not the main output and not what makes a retrospective good.", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A task list per person — some tasks may be determined, but that is not the main output and not what makes a retrospective good.", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (động từ): xác định. Determine tasks/the cause = xác định công việc/nguyên nhân; tính từ determined = quyết tâm.
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (verb): to decide or establish. Determine tasks or the cause means establish them; the adjective determined means resolute.

items.question: Trong câu "The retrospective is also where the Stimulate collaboration and continuous improvement principle shows most clearly.", từ "stimulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The retrospective is also where the Stimulate collaboration and continuous improvement principle shows most clearly.", what does "stimulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stimulate /ˈstɪm.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): thúc đẩy, khuyến khích. Stimulate collaboration/growth = thúc đẩy hợp tác/tăng trưởng; đừng nhầm với simulate (mô phỏng).
items.explanationEn: stimulate /ˈstɪm.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to encourage something to grow. Stimulate collaboration or growth means encourage it; do not confuse with simulate.

items.question: Trong câu "The retrospective is also where the Stimulate collaboration and continuous improvement principle shows most clearly.", từ "collaboration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The retrospective is also where the Stimulate collaboration and continuous improvement principle shows most clearly.", what does "collaboration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hợp tác. Collaboration between teams = sự hợp tác giữa các nhóm; động từ collaborate with.
items.explanationEn: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): working together. Collaboration between teams means working together; the verb is collaborate with.

items.question: Trong câu "If a question pairs an event with a principle, the correct pair is", từ "pair" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a question pairs an event with a principle, the correct pair is", what does "pair" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pair /peər/ (động từ): ghép đôi, kết hợp. Pair A with B = ghép A với B; danh từ a pair (một cặp). Đừng nhầm với repair.
items.explanationEn: pair /peər/ (verb): to put two things together. Pair A with B means match them together; the noun is a pair. Do not confuse with repair.

items.question: Trong câu "Detailed design options are discussed during story elaboration, BEFORE the iteration begins — not in the planning workshop, not in the review, not in the retrospective.", từ "option" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Detailed design options are discussed during story elaboration, BEFORE the iteration begins — not in the planning workshop, not in the review, not in the retrospective.", what does "option" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: option /ˈɒp.ʃən/ (danh từ): phương án lựa chọn. Design options = các phương án thiết kế; tính từ optional (tùy chọn).
items.explanationEn: option /ˈɒp.ʃən/ (noun): a possible choice. Design options are the possible design choices; the adjective is optional.

items.question: Trong câu "Detailed design options are discussed during story elaboration, BEFORE the iteration begins — not in the planning workshop, not in the review, not in the retrospective.", từ "elaboration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Detailed design options are discussed during story elaboration, BEFORE the iteration begins — not in the planning workshop, not in the review, not in the retrospective.", what does "elaboration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: elaboration /ɪˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự làm rõ chi tiết. Story elaboration = làm rõ chi tiết một user story (tiêu chí chấp nhận, thiết kế) trước khi làm.
items.explanationEn: elaboration /ɪˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the process of adding detail. Story elaboration adds detail to a user story, such as criteria and design, before the work starts.

items.question: Trong câu "By the time the team walks into a planning session those design choices should already have been made; planning only splits the work into tasks.", từ "by the time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "By the time the team walks into a planning session those design choices should already have been made; planning only splits the work into tasks.", what does "by the time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by the time /baɪ ðə taɪm/ (cụm từ): trước lúc, khi mà (đã). By the time + mệnh đề, thường đi với thì hoàn thành: by the time we start, it should have been done.
items.explanationEn: by the time /baɪ ðə taɪm/ (phrase): before or when something happens. By the time is usually followed by a perfect tense: by the time we start, it should have been done.

items.question: Trong câu "By the time the team walks into a planning session those design choices should already have been made; planning only splits the work into tasks.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "By the time the team walks into a planning session those design choices should already have been made; planning only splits the work into tasks.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia nhỏ ra. Split the work into tasks = chia công việc thành các task; quá khứ vẫn là split.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. Split the work into tasks; the past form is also split.

items.question: Trong câu "Story elaboration lives mostly at the delivery horizon, although backlog refinement at the initiative horizon does include some elaboration of features and creation of stories.", từ "horizon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story elaboration lives mostly at the delivery horizon, although backlog refinement at the initiative horizon does include some elaboration of features and creation of stories.", what does "horizon" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the line where earth meets sky
items.explanation: horizon /həˈraɪ.zən/ (danh từ): tầm, phạm vi thời gian. Trong Agile Extension có ba horizon: strategy, initiative, delivery; nghĩa gốc là đường chân trời.
items.explanationEn: horizon /həˈraɪ.zən/ (noun): a planning time range. The Agile Extension uses three horizons: strategy, initiative and delivery; literally it is the skyline.

items.question: Trong câu "Story elaboration lives mostly at the delivery horizon, although backlog refinement at the initiative horizon does include some elaboration of features and creation of stories.", từ "although" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story elaboration lives mostly at the delivery horizon, although backlog refinement at the initiative horizon does include some elaboration of features and creation of stories.", what does "although" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: although /ɔːlˈðəʊ/ (liên từ): mặc dù. Although + mệnh đề = mặc dù; không dùng although cùng but trong một câu.
items.explanationEn: although /ɔːlˈðəʊ/ (conjunction): despite the fact that. Although introduces a contrasting clause; do not combine although with but.

items.question: Trong câu "Story elaboration lives mostly at the delivery horizon, although backlog refinement at the initiative horizon does include some elaboration of features and creation of stories.", từ "initiative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story elaboration lives mostly at the delivery horizon, although backlog refinement at the initiative horizon does include some elaboration of features and creation of stories.", what does "initiative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: initiative /ɪˈnɪʃ.ə.tɪv/ (danh từ): sáng kiến, dự án lớn. Initiative horizon = tầm sáng kiến (nhóm tính năng lớn); cụm khác: take the initiative (chủ động).
items.explanationEn: initiative /ɪˈnɪʃ.ə.tɪv/ (noun): a large planned effort. The initiative horizon covers a large planned effort; another sense appears in take the initiative.

items.question: Trong câu "Observation is the delivery-horizon technique used to understand how users actually perform a task or use the solution.", từ "observation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Observation is the delivery-horizon technique used to understand how users actually perform a task or use the solution.", what does "observation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: observation /ˌɒb.zəˈveɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự quan sát. Observation (job shadowing) = quan sát người dùng làm việc thực tế; động từ observe.
items.explanationEn: observation /ˌɒb.zəˈveɪ.ʃən/ (noun): watching carefully. Observation, or job shadowing, means watching users do real work; the verb is observe.

items.question: Trong câu "Observation is the delivery-horizon technique used to understand how users actually perform a task or use the solution.", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Observation is the delivery-horizon technique used to understand how users actually perform a task or use the solution.", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to run at a certain speed
items.explanation: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (động từ): thực hiện. Perform a task = thực hiện công việc; perform well = hoạt động tốt (hiệu năng).
items.explanationEn: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (verb): to carry out a task. Perform a task means carry it out; perform well refers to good results or speed.

items.question: Trong câu "Three techniques are commonly offered against it", từ "commonly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three techniques are commonly offered against it", what does "commonly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: commonly /ˈkɒm.ən.li/ (trạng từ): thường, phổ biến. Commonly used/offered = thường được dùng/đưa ra; tính từ common.
items.explanationEn: commonly /ˈkɒm.ən.li/ (adverb): often, usually. Commonly used or offered means frequently so; the adjective is common.

items.question: Trong câu "Three techniques are commonly offered against it", từ "offer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three techniques are commonly offered against it", what does "offer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put forward as a choice
items.explanation: offer /ˈɒf.ər/ (động từ): đưa ra (làm phương án). Offered against it = được đưa ra để cạnh tranh/đối chiếu với nó (làm phương án nhiễu).
items.explanationEn: offer /ˈɒf.ər/ (verb): to put forward as a choice. Offered against it means put forward as competing choices, such as distractors.

items.question: Trong câu "Help communicate and analyse user tasks, but do not help you", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Help communicate and analyse user tasks, but do not help you", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): truyền đạt. Communicate requirements to the team = truyền đạt yêu cầu cho nhóm; danh từ communication.
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to share information. Communicate requirements to the team; the noun is communication.

items.question: Trong câu "Define the boundaries of a story and help verify and validate that the solution met the need — not an investigative tool", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define the boundaries of a story and help verify and validate that the solution met the need — not an investigative tool", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to check it is built correctly
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): kiểm chứng (làm đúng). Verify = kiểm tra làm đúng đặc tả (build it right); validate = kiểm tra đúng nhu cầu (build the right thing).
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to check it is built correctly. Verify checks it was built right against the spec; validate checks the right thing was built.

items.question: Trong câu "Define the boundaries of a story and help verify and validate that the solution met the need — not an investigative tool", từ "validate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define the boundaries of a story and help verify and validate that the solution met the need — not an investigative tool", what does "validate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to confirm it meets the real need
items.explanation: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): xác nhận (đáp ứng nhu cầu). Validate that the solution met the need = xác nhận giải pháp đáp ứng nhu cầu; danh từ validation.
items.explanationEn: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to confirm it meets the real need. Validate that the solution met the need; the noun is validation.

items.question: Trong câu "Define the boundaries of a story and help verify and validate that the solution met the need — not an investigative tool", từ "investigative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define the boundaries of a story and help verify and validate that the solution met the need — not an investigative tool", what does "investigative" (adjective) mean?
options: mang tính điều tra, tìm hiểu
items.explanation: investigative /ɪnˈves.tɪ.ɡə.tɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính điều tra, tìm hiểu. Investigative tool = công cụ để điều tra, tìm hiểu; động từ investigate.
items.explanationEn: investigative /ɪnˈves.tɪ.ɡə.tɪv/ (adjective): used to find things out. An investigative tool helps you find things out; the verb is investigate.

items.question: Trong câu "Assesses ideas in the context of customer and business value — a strategy-horizon technique", từ "assess" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assesses ideas in the context of customer and business value — a strategy-horizon technique", what does "assess" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assess /əˈses/ (động từ): đánh giá. Assess ideas/risk = đánh giá ý tưởng/rủi ro; danh từ assessment (bài đánh giá, kỳ thi).
items.explanationEn: assess /əˈses/ (verb): to evaluate. Assess ideas or risk means evaluate them; the noun is assessment.

items.question: Trong câu "Assesses ideas in the context of customer and business value — a strategy-horizon technique", từ "in the context of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assesses ideas in the context of customer and business value — a strategy-horizon technique", what does "in the context of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in the context of /ɪn ðə ˈkɒn.tekst əv/ (cụm từ): xét trong bối cảnh của. In the context of = xét trong bối cảnh/khía cạnh của; ví dụ in the context of business value.
items.explanationEn: in the context of /ɪn ðə ˈkɒn.tekst əv/ (phrase): considered in relation to. In the context of means considered in relation to, e.g. in the context of business value.

items.question: Trong câu "Assesses ideas in the context of customer and business value — a strategy-horizon technique", từ "value" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assesses ideas in the context of customer and business value — a strategy-horizon technique", what does "value" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the data held by a variable
items.explanation: value /ˈvæl.juː/ (danh từ): giá trị, lợi ích. Business/customer value = giá trị cho doanh nghiệp/khách hàng; cụm: deliver value.
items.explanationEn: value /ˈvæl.juː/ (noun): worth or benefit. Business or customer value is benefit delivered; collocation: deliver value.

items.question: Trong câu "The four events have sharply separated purposes; the wrong answer is always another real event.", từ "sharply" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four events have sharply separated purposes; the wrong answer is always another real event.", what does "sharply" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: sharply /ˈʃɑːp.li/ (trạng từ): rõ rệt, dứt khoát. Sharply separated = tách biệt rõ rệt; cụm khác: prices fell sharply (giảm mạnh).
items.explanationEn: sharply /ˈʃɑːp.li/ (adverb): clearly and distinctly. Sharply separated means clearly distinct; another use: prices fell sharply.

items.question: Trong câu "The four events have sharply separated purposes; the wrong answer is always another real event.", từ "separate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four events have sharply separated purposes; the wrong answer is always another real event.", what does "separate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsep.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): tách biệt. Separate A from B = tách A khỏi B; tính từ separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ = riêng biệt.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsep.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to keep apart. Separate A from B keeps them apart; the adjective separate means distinct.

items.question: Trong câu "The four events have sharply separated purposes; the wrong answer is always another real event.", từ "purpose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four events have sharply separated purposes; the wrong answer is always another real event.", what does "purpose" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: purpose /ˈpɜː.pəs/ (danh từ): mục đích. The purpose of a review = mục đích của buổi review; cụm: on purpose (cố ý).
items.explanationEn: purpose /ˈpɜː.pəs/ (noun): the reason something exists. The purpose of a review is why it is held; the phrase on purpose means deliberately.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog refinement is the input to a planning workshop, and it is continuous.", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog refinement is the input to a planning workshop, and it is continuous.", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
options: sự làm rõ, hoàn thiện dần
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (danh từ): sự làm rõ, hoàn thiện dần. Backlog refinement = làm rõ, ước lượng và sắp xếp backlog liên tục (trước gọi là grooming).
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪn.mənt/ (noun): gradual clarifying and improving. Backlog refinement is ongoing clarifying, estimating and ordering of items, once called grooming.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog refinement is the input to a planning workshop, and it is continuous.", từ "continuous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog refinement is the input to a planning workshop, and it is continuous.", what does "continuous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (tính từ): liên tục, diễn ra suốt. Continuous improvement = cải tiến liên tục; phân biệt continual (lặp lại nhiều lần, có ngắt quãng).
items.explanationEn: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (adjective): ongoing without stopping. Continuous improvement never stops; compare continual, which means repeated with breaks.
